status_summary: No proposed or final OCR rule since 2025-01-20 on crisis standards of care, quality-adjusted life years or denial of treatment to disabled newborns was found. HHS published a proposed rule on 2025-12-19 that would amend only the Section 504 exclusions provision on gender dysphoria, and the proposal declined a full repeal of the 2024 Section 504 rule as broader than necessary, leaving that rule's existing provisions in place.
title: Issue disability rules on crisis standards of care, QALYs and denial of care to newborns
uncertainties: The December 2025 proposed rule was re-read in review: it revises only 45 CFR 84.4(g), does not address crisis standards, value assessment, life-sustaining treatment or newborns, and declines a full repeal of the 2024 rule. The 2024 Section 504 final rule (89 FR 40066) is reported to contain value assessment and medical treatment provisions that overlap in part with the recommendation; that rule predates the period, its text was not opened, and it is not counted here. No 2025 to 2026 OCR action on those provisions was found; the states' challenge in Texas v. Kennedy is reported to concern the integration provisions. The Trump-era drafts and the older newborn rule were not located. Searches run: Section 504 value assessment 2025 2026; Federal Register API on Section 504 and OCR.
